تنتصبن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَصِبْنَ (tantaṣibna) /tan.ta.sˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# تُنْتَصَبْنَ (tuntaṣabna) /tun.ta.sˤab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
